task: Welcome to another profound session of TextWorld! Here is how to play! First off, if it's not too much trouble, I need you to head west. Then, open the gateway. And then, venture north. Once you accomplish that, make an effort to head west. Next, make sure that the hatch within the cookery is opened. After opening the hatch, take a trip north. After that, pick-up the legume from the floor of the bedroom. And if you do that, you're the winner!
description:
You've just shown up in a cookhouse. You decide to just list off a complete list of everything you see in the room, because hey, why not?

You make out a closed fridge. You rest your hand against a wall, but you miss the wall and fall onto a pan. Make a note of this, you might have to put stuff on or in it later on. But there isn't a thing on it. You swear loudly.

There is an open passageway leading north. There is an open portal leading west.

thought: The portal to the west is open, so I should go west through it.
feedback:
You arrive in a normal kind of place. That is to say, you're in a scullery. Let's see what's in here.

You make out a chair. The chair is usual. But oh no! there's nothing on this piece of junk.

There is a closed gateway leading north. There is an open portal leading east.
